changes.title: Correct private speed-picker device test and retain failed evidence
changes.text: Fix a duplicate local variable in Android touch acceptance for the private ten-speed picker; game and developer-only playback implementation remain identical to the previously compiled APK. Retain the initial failed Android instrumentation compiler evidence, full core pass, and strict previous APK history.

commentary: TEST270 producer job compiled an APK and passed 1779 core methods, history and debug compilation, but required Android instrumentation failed to compile due a duplicate local name in the new test. TEST271 corrects the test only and requests full Android acceptance and all 57 screenshots; no publication or distribution.
